commits.message:
Pin that a removable control between a glyph and its extender writes as wide as it measures under every order (rich-control-codes-xh4n.5md)

RichText.measure has read orient's measured(text, order) since #534, so it
drops the controls the wire drops; the probe that filed this compared raw
cellLen against a removing order's row. Every order and span edge agreed on
master; this pins it, and fails if measure stops being order-aware.

iTerm2 and Terminal.app measured and kept plain (rich-control-codes-xh4n.gp4) (#562)

* iTerm2 and Terminal.app measured and kept plain (rich-control-codes-xh4n.gp4)

* Name the measured versions and PDF's cell, pin Terminal.app plain, and say it in the docs (rich-control-codes-xh4n.gp4)

* Drop the unmeasured logical advice for Terminal.app; say which build the bidi rows came from (rich-control-codes-xh4n.gp4)

* Keep the bidi measurement in one place; name seal's closers and the unmeasured reordering (rich-control-codes-xh4n.gp4)
